description: Narrative: carried across a bridge hidden in a tractor-trailer; form manner AFOOT (mode conflict)

anchors: hid him and four other people inside the trailer of a tractor-trailer

labelNotes: Both the narrative and the form say the subject was not inspected, so the inspection category agrees and the charge is supported.
